articles.title: UK Government Warns Visa Applicants Against These 5 Actions Before Approval
articles.description: The UK government has warned foreign visa applicants against five risky actions, including selling property and resigning from jobs, before receiving a decision.

articles.title: Pakistan is going to the Moon, but China is giving it the lift: Meet ‘Jinnah-1’, Islamabad’s first lunar rover
articles.description: Pakistan has named its first lunar rover “Jinnah-1”, with the mission planned for 2029. The rover will travel aboard China’s Chang’e-8 mission and explore the Moon’s south polar region.
